about: Models Tempo setup may recommend. Public engines are copied from the verified public catalog (model_catalog.json in the public Perennos Tempo repository, verified 2026-10-17 against the Ollama registry); nothing here is invented. gb is the download size; null means unknown, and a model of unknown size is never chosen by size. min_ram_gb and min_vram_gb are gb plus 1.5 GB of room for the model's working memory (context); null when gb is null. To add a model, put a file with the same shape at <Tempo home>/models/catalog.json: its entries replace entries of the same name and add new ones.
